title: Ali ke chahne wale khushi aise manate hai
body:
Ali ke chahne wale khushi aise manate hai
ali ali ali ali ali Haider..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Haider haider haider
Ali k chahne wale khushi aise manate he
<<DIVIDER>>
lagate haideri naare jo chehre muskurate he
1. hamari bandagi maula hamari zindagi maula
<<DIVIDER>>
nabi ne kehdiya maula jisse bus he wahi maula
sikhaya maa ne apni looriyo me yaa ali maula
<<DIVIDER>>
ghadeere kum ka kissa apne bacho ko sunate he
2. khula karta he haj ke darmiya khushiyo ka darwaza
<<DIVIDER>>
tawaf aisa he hota jhumta he khaanaye kaaba
dilome azmate tauheed lab par ya ali maula
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda k ghar ali paida huwe sabko batate he
3. jo kehlata he momin karbala ka he wo bashinda
<<DIVIDER>>
mazalim k mukabil khoon se rehta he payinda
ali par jaan dekar ye hamesha hogaye zinda
<<DIVIDER>>
shaheedo k to chehre b kafan me muskurate he
4. koi bhooda b aajaye to wo hokar jawaa uthe
<<DIVIDER>>
dilo se naaraye haider zami ta asma uthe
mere har shair par dilse munafik k dua uthe
<<DIVIDER>>
jo munkir he ali k unko lafzo se jalate he
5. musalsal koshisho k batbi nakaam tha lashkar
<<DIVIDER>>
alam jisko payamber se mila wo mard he haider
mawali sab ikhatte hogaye he saj gaya khaiber
<<DIVIDER>>
jo shachi baat hoti he wohi sabko batate he
6. bhulaya tha shabe meraaj jisko haqne apna tha
<<DIVIDER>>
bohot nazdik tha mehboob bus kehne ko parda tha
khuda ne baat ki jisme bohot manoos lehja tha
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ki thi anghuti aur ali ka haath dekha tha
bohot khush he nabi meraaj se tashreef laate he
<<DIVIDER>>
7. yaha he sakiye kausar yaha jannat k dar b he
malaik he yaha maujood aur jinno bashar b he
<<DIVIDER>>
fazayai he yaha athar ali safdar kamar b he
ye aisi bazm he jisme
<<DIVIDER>>
imame asr aate he
8. jo apne rokh ko pehle dinse hi haider se moode he
<<DIVIDER>>
ali k daig ko dekha to kitni taiz doode he
faraar aise huwa aage k peeche unke ghoode he
<<DIVIDER>>
hum unka zikr karte he jo aadhi bhagoode he
hai adat baagne ki jinko hum unko bhagate he
<<DIVIDER>>
9. yahi rakhte he rooze raat din he ye dua karte
fariza khums ka har toor se he ye ada karte
<<DIVIDER>>
ali waale nahi hargiz namazo ko kaza karte
namazome khuda k samne sar ko jhukate he
author: Ali Safdar
